_note: Weekly star for families (T-125, D-118). The teacher approves this once in setup; code fills only {child} from the register. whatsApp is the body of the Meta template weekly_star_v1 ({{1}} = {child}), shown so she approves what goes out; message and badge are the two screens of the page.
